description: Run a statistical significance test and get the statistic, p-value, effect size, confidence interval and a plain-English verdict — results match scipy.stats. Tests: Welch / Student two-sample t, paired t, one-sample t, one-proportion z, A/B test of two conversion rates (pooled z, lift, CI of the difference), chi-square goodness of fit and independence (Yates for 2×2, Cramér's V), one-way ANOVA (η²), Kruskal–Wallis, Mann–Whitney U (exact for small samples, rank-biserial r), Wilcoxon signed-rank (exact / permutation / normal), Pearson and Spearman correlation (Fisher-z CI) and Fisher's exact test. Two-sided or one-sided alternatives. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hypothesis-test

a.description: Sample A (or x for correlations, or the differences for wilcoxon)

expected.description: chi-square-gof expected counts or proportions (default: uniform)

groups.description: anova / kruskal-wallis: array of samples, or an object of named samples

table.description: Contingency table (rows of counts) for chi-square-independence / fisher-exact (2×2)

yates.description: chi-square-independence: Yates continuity correction for 2×2 tables
